fixes.old: Architecture v5 slide 18 names GuaranteeClaimFiled and GuaranteeClaimSettled; the AsyncAPI document carries the single message GuaranteeClaim (GAP-1996; ASM-3223).
fixes.new: This service publishes the two claim events of Architecture v5 slide 18: GuaranteeClaimFiled when the claim is submitted and GuaranteeClaimSettled when it is paid or released. Both are keyed by case (`caseId`) and carry identifiers and facts only (GAP-1727). The payload fields are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-1727). Their rows are added to the event catalogue and Microservice Ownership Map v1 when the EV numbers are allocated. The AsyncAPI document of 22 November 2026 carries the single message GuaranteeClaim; the two events named here replace that name in this specification (GAP-1727).

disposition.note: TSD now publishes both events. Still to change elsewhere: event catalogue and Ownership Map (once EV numbers allocated), and rwb-guarantee.asyncapi.yaml and index.yaml.
